summary: Compressed discussion signals: Google Workspace MCP rollout and enforcement chatter; Anthropic's Siren sandbox-eval revealed; Grok/xAI data-leak reporting; operator pain with terminal coding agents and device-approval UX; multiple infra primitives (Brickie, Pomerado, SEC429) gaining social attention. | Vendor-focused snapshot: high‑severity advisories (Claude TOCTOU, MCP OAuth), major platform updates (Microsoft Foundry, Vercel, AWS Bedrock), sandbox/runtime pushes (E2B, Modal, Daytona) and new model/product launches (Mistral, OpenRouter, JetBrains). Several vendor customer stories document operator scaling patterns. | GitHub OSS snapshot: active agent platforms, SDK/harness releases, and rising infra for MCP/sandbox and agent security. High-signal releases from Qwen, Vercel, OpenAI and large platforms; many operator-facing CLIs and desktop managers require social/field corroboration. | Packages shard: many infra primitives for agent memory, MCP, sandboxes, and security; two high-traction mainstream products (OpenAI VS Code extension, Amazon ECS agent). Missing social/operator field reports.
